manipulators.description: Change caps_lock to left_control. (Post escape if pressed alone)
Change left_ctrl + j as soft-Enter (add a new line)
Change quote to left_control. (Post quote if pressed alone)
Make Tab my hyper (left_command + left_control + left_option + left_shift). (Post Tab if pressed alone)
ctrl+w to delete the word behind the cursor
ctrl+e to move to the end of the current line
ctrl+a to move to the beginning of the current line
ctrl+u to delete the line behind the cursor
ctrl+k to delete the line after the cursor

rules.description: Option+d to delete the word after the cursor
Option+f to move one word forward
Option+b to move one word backward

manipulators.description: Terminal: ctrl+enter to ◊ (Option + Shift + v on Mac OS)
Terminal: shift+enter to Ø (Option + Shift + o on Mac OS)
Terminal: ctrl+slash to ÷ (Option + slash on Mac OS)

rules.description: Shift keys as parenteses if pressed alone

manipulators.description: Post ) if right_shift is pressed alone
